name: LinkedIn
summary: Sign-in and posting as the member are self-serve and instant. Anything company-page or marketing related is partner-gated: you apply, LinkedIn vets you, and approval isn't guaranteed.

composio.note: Composio-managed works for the standard scopes. LinkedIn won't combine some scopes in one app (e.g. w_member_social with r_organization_admin), so those need your own app.

capabilities.label: Sign In with LinkedIn (OIDC)
capabilities.why: Self-serve product, added automatically to new apps

capabilities.label: Manage company pages
capabilities.why: Community Management API: access request plus vetting, development tier first

gates.label: Community Management API vetting
gates.plain: LinkedIn vets your company and use case, then a second review for full access.

steps.title: Create (or pick) a LinkedIn Company Page
steps.detail: Every app must be associated with a company page, and a page super admin has to verify the association.
steps.human: Create the page or ask its super admin to verify the app

steps.title: Create the developer app
steps.detail: Add the self-serve products (Sign In with LinkedIn using OIDC, Share on LinkedIn) and redirect URLs (Composio BYO: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback).
steps.agent: Configure the products and redirect URLs

steps.title: Create a separate app just for Community Management
steps.detail: Community Management has to be the only product on its app. The request button is greyed out if other products are attached.
steps.human: Create it and verify it with the page

steps.title: Submit the access request form
steps.detail: Use a company email (personal email addresses fail vetting). Describe a supported use case that complies with the Marketing API terms.
steps.agent: Draft the use-case description against the API terms

steps.title: Build on the development tier, then request the Standard tier
steps.detail: The Standard tier needs a fully integrated app and a second review (screencast and test access).
steps.agent: Build against the dev tier; prepare the review materials

alternatives.label: Post as the member (w_member_social) instead of as the company page
alternatives.tradeoff: Posts appear on the person's profile, not the company page.

launchToday: Ship sign-in plus posting as the member today. Both are self-serve.
Apply for Community Management on a separate app now if you'll ever need company pages. Vetting is slow and uncertain.
rejections: Personal email or an unverified company page on the access request
Use case not supported by the Marketing API terms (e.g. scraping, automating member outreach)
The app has other products attached (Community Management must be alone)
Requesting Standard tier before the integration is complete

blockers.problem: The Community Management request button is greyed out
blockers.fix: Remove other products, or create a new app that only has Community Management.
File a vetting appeal through the LinkedIn contact form (Form Type: Vetting Appeal) with your client ID.

uncertain: LinkedIn doesn't publish vetting times. The ranges shown are estimates.
